summary: The acceptance shape (acceptance relative to its plateau) is divided out as an extra per-bin 'geometric efficiency' although the exposure already contains the full acceptance, so the acceptance energy dependence is corrected twice.
code_change: run_analysis multiplies the selection efficiency passed to analyse() by acceptance(sp)/acc_max, while w['exposure'] still equals acceptance x livetime x cutoff fraction.
description_change: recipe.json gains a step 'acceptance' (operator correct_efficiency) before 'exposure'; the spec's acceptance correction notes now say the acceptance shape is corrected in the estimator and its absolute value enters the exposure.
